highlight.title: The Pragmatic Engineer: How AI Changed Engineering Roles in 2026
highlight.summary: Based on 900+ developer responses, this survey reveals how AI tools are reshaping engineering work. Teams are hitting spending concerns while dealing with new role dynamics—engineers orchestrating more than coding, managers getting more hands-on, and a concerning rise in 'AI slop' from less experienced developers relying too heavily on tools.

resources.title: GitHub Universe 2026: Call for Speakers Opens
resources.why_now: GitHub's flagship developer conference returns to San Francisco Oct 28-29, with speaker submissions due May 1. The focus on 'Ship & Tell' format for startup builders and AI-powered workflows reflects where the industry conversation is heading.

resources.title: Learn to Code in 2026: Why Everything Changed
resources.why_now: This developer's reflection on learning in the AI era captures a critical tension: AI makes coding faster but threatens to erode fundamental skills. The advice to 'resist shortcuts' while leveraging AI tools is increasingly relevant for new developers.

resources.title: 5 Programming Languages to Master in 2026
resources.why_now: As AI tools handle more routine coding, this guide emphasizes languages that remain human-critical: Python for AI/data, SQL for databases, and JavaScript for web development. The 'Human in the Loop' concept becomes central to career planning.

resources.title: Best Tech Engineering Blogs Worth Following
resources.why_now: With rapid AI changes, staying current through quality engineering blogs becomes essential. This curated list of 30 blogs—from Meta's deep technical content to Stripe's API design insights—helps developers learn from real-world scale challenges.

claude_take: The 2026 engineering landscape feels like a watershed moment where AI tools have moved from 'nice to have' to essential, but the real differentiator is knowing when NOT to use them. The most interesting tension isn't human vs AI—it's experienced developers who can orchestrate AI effectively vs those who become dependent on it for thinking.
